text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe's racing Racewear has arrived.
I decided to look for her to deliver the news. However――

In my rush, I dropped my Trainer badge
somewhere—!
I search for it, but it's too dark to spot anything easily...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you dropped something...

All of a sudden—
Manhattan Cafe appeared like a shadow and found the Trainer badge.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I found it, from within the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When you're hidden in the shadows,
you can see and hear everything so clearly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Far more vividly, far more intensely
than simply looking at the physical body—

I couldn't understand right away,
but she must have had her reasons.
Anyway, when I told her about the racing outfit, she mentioned she'd like to try it on, so we agreed to meet up at the track again.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Cool, like the shade of a tree...
Smooth, like the dark of night...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And melting into the shadows—
quietly, tenaciously...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so...
With this racing attire, surely—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm, hmm! So that's your racing outfit, Cafe.
Well then, why not run alongside me as part of an experiment?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You really pop up out of nowhere, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Come now, don't be so cold.
Aren't you curious as well? For instance,
about the changes a Racewear brings about in an Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Now then... I wonder how it'll go.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: However, I don't mind if it's a tandem run... There's something I wanted to try out myself anyway...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
May I go?
Under the radiant clear sky, both contenders bolted forward!

Agnes Tachyon took the lead,
with Manhattan Cafe giving chase.
Soon, as they approached the final stretch—

Manhattan Cafe, running behind,
seemed to vanish—or so it felt!
Almost as if she were a running shadow...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, nobody told me about this?!
What was with... that final burst of acceleration?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To borrow your words, yes—
it was just like they 'emerged from the shadows'!
I couldn't see them at all until they got close!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It might not be "just like" shadows...
She really might be emerging right out of them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
When you say it, it doesn't sound like a joke at all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"However, 'emerged from the shadows', huh...
They say a racing outfit brings an Umamusume emotional stability and exhilaration, but—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, if it's causing supernatural phenomena,
one can't help but call it exceptional!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's check that video!
Just what could be different from before—?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............
Trainer... what did you think?
choice_data_list: It looked like you vanished into thin air.
Does that racing outfit have something to do with shadows?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then it went just as planned...
After all, I was lurking in the shadows...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "I had this racing attire made... so that I could 'blend into the shadows'..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In other words, wearing this is just like being in the shadows...
And in my case, I see the world
much better from within the shadows...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
With this, I should be able to face
races in bright daylight with peace of mind...

I felt like I understood her relationship with shadows a little better.
To her, shadows might very well be
her greatest ally.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Just as I said earlier...
When you're in the shadows, you can see everything.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
All you see from a physical body is its outward form...
But within the shadow, you can see everything they carry—their spirit, their feelings...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm sure...
I'll be able to shine even more than before...

It's a perspective so typical of her, cherishing the invisible things.
With this, she'll be able to demonstrate her true potential
even more in races.
